DRAW. LISTEN. PLAY.

Let the paper sing.

  1. Choose a color. Each color has a different synthesized instrument voice. Tap ♪ to hear it.
  2. Draw a mark. Left and right choose when it sounds. Up and down choose the note. A horizontal line holds a note; changing height changes pitch.
  3. Press Play. The moving line reads your marks from left to right. Turn Loop off to play once.
  4. Bring a picture. Open a drawing to hear its colors, play it with one instrument, or trace it silently.
  5. Keep it. Save an editable drawing, an editable sequence, a PNG of the selected drawing, or WAV/MP4 of all sections. MP4 includes musical labels and a moving playhead. Edits also autosave on this device.

Import plans as sections, arrange their order, and press Play sequence. Each section keeps its own tempo, key and scale. Bar grouping (3/4, 4/4 or 6/4) changes the labels, not the notes. Up to 64 sections and 10 minutes play/export at once.

A melody guide is silent until you trace it or choose “Make guide playable”. For separate repeated notes, lift your pen between strokes. Dense pictures are limited to 12 simultaneous notes; the app tells you when this happens.

Keyboard: P for pen, E for eraser, Space for Play/Stop, Ctrl/Command Z for Undo. For a keyboard-only starting point, try the garden or import a drawing.
